svg.title: Global Multi-Frontier LUT Synthesis: Antisymmetric 40-Entry T-MAC, SEU Resilience, openXC7 Post-PAR Bitstream, Aeneas Rust-to-Lean, and 14.74 KB WebAssembly
svg.desc: Four-panel summary of Claims LA-33 through LA-35: (A) ISCA 2025 antisymmetric 40-entry T-MAC table symmetrization across Jetson AGX Thor DC shunt measured_j, AMD Zen 5 RAPL reported_j, Apple M5 Max, and live Alif Ensemble E3 Cortex-M55 DWT cycles; (B) TMLR July 2026 cosmic-ray SEU parameter bit-flip resilience with (72,64) RAMB36 Extended Hamming SECDED and 0x3C apoptosis achieving 100.0% survival at 1% BER vs 26.28% BF16; (C) Lupanov k=8 -72.5% shared-cofactor reduction, TreeLUT 1-LUT6 GBDT collapse, KAN-LUT zero-FLOP B-splines, and license-free openXC7 320.62 MHz post-PAR timing closure and 77.85 Mbit .bit bitstream on Artix-7 XC7A200T-2FBG484-2; and (D) Inria Charon + Aeneas mechanical #![no_std] Rust MIR to Lean 4.36.0 verification, 50 six-kernel LutAdapt theorems (1,414 fleet), and 14.74 KB browser-native lut6_core.wasm.
